config.text:
Select a method and a return period.


Click on a point on the main map (the use of the flow accumulation guide is advised).


After the delineation of the watershed, please click the "Fetch Precipitation" button.


A summary of data and a statistical value for the precipitation will appear.

config.text:
After the delineation of the watershed, please click the "Fetch Precipitation" button.

It calculates the mean precipitation of the delineated watershed, based on the selected method and time/period scenario.


Keep in mind, the button will only work after the watershed has been delineated.
